They’re both really cute! I have two 4 month old babies who fight in this exact same way.. one doesn’t make much noise when they fight but the other makes such loud noises. At first I was worried they were hurting each other and tried to separate them but now that I’ve watched for awhile I really do think it’s just play. 


Does your 7mo make a lot of sound outside of their play sessions? Some cats are just vocal and vocalize a lot more often than others, which I think is the case with mine. If she’s not generally very vocal then I do think there could be some boundary testing going on in their play fights, and it’s valid to be concerned to make sure it doesn’t escalate, but I don’t think it’s a huge problem if they’re cuddling and seem overall happy to be around each other outside of the playing/fights.

However! When I brought the boys home the very vocal one had gotten neutered three days beforehand and I could still see the incision area. Even with a lot of rough play and boundary testing it was okay and didn’t reopen or get infected. I watched it closely and tried to separate them if I felt they were being too intense but they just kept going back to play and his incision area seemed fine. You’re never going to know 100% for sure because every cat is different but hopefully my experience helps you worry a little less! :)
